_readme: WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR
Hand corrections to the ALL-INDIA point layers, applied by prep/build_all_india_rollups.py.
Edit here, re-run that script, and the fix survives every future rebuild of the source layers.
Never hand-edit all-india-health-points.json or all-india-language-points.json: those are
regenerated from the workbook, the JSONL and the TSVs, and your edits would be overwritten.
HOW A RULE WORKS
match  - any subset of point fields (name, city, state, subtype, source, latitude...).
Compared as strings, case-insensitively. ALL listed fields must match.
set    - fields to overwrite on the matched point.
drop   - true removes the point entirely.
_disabled - true parks a rule without deleting it. The examples below are parked.
The FIRST matching rule wins per point, so put narrow rules above broad ones.
Corrected points are tagged manuallyEdited:true so you can audit them later.
WHEN TO REACH FOR IT
1. A coordinate is plainly wrong (facility lands in the sea, or in the wrong state).
2. The same facility appears twice under two source lists - drop one.
3. A city or state is blank or misspelled and you know the right value.
4. An ownership value is wrong for a specific institution.
Anything systematic - a whole category mis-classified, a parsing rule that fails for
hundreds of rows - belongs in the prep script, not here. This file is for one-offs.
FOR THE 15-CITY PILOT LAYER, edit via prep/reconcile_flags.py instead: that layer has its
own eligibility and coordinate-flag pipeline and does not read this file.
